items.source_name: Top Indian News / inshorts / nowlivo / The Logical Indian
items.summary: Hours after his Oct-20 16-minute video called jailed co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka the movement's 'real leaders' and said he 'just followed their orders', social-media trolls alleged Dipke was shifting responsibility onto them to keep himself out of controversy. Late on Oct 20, Dipke posted a clarification video: 'I'm not throwing them under the bus but taking pride in having better people by my side... Saurav and Ashu are not just better leaders than me but also better people.' The clarification was carried by The Logical Indian's verified IG reel (Oct 21 ~12:05 PM IST).
items.title: Dipke clarifies 'real leaders' remark after trolling alleged he threw jailed Das and Ranka 'under the bus'
